subject.title: feat(auto-reply): add "commentary" verbose level for narration-only progress

question: Should `commentary` become a persistent global/per-agent `verboseDefault` value despite the downgrade boundary, or remain a session and channel-level control?
rationale: The narration-only behavior is proven and the lane implementation is coherent, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces and the released strict schema cannot read the new value after downgrade.

options.title: Keep It Session-Level
options.body: Retain `/verbose commentary` and session persistence while removing the global and per-agent default enum additions, avoiding the downgrade break.

options.title: Approve Persistent Defaults
options.body: Keep the config value and explicitly own, document, and validate the downgrade failure and required operator recovery.

options.title: Use Channel Controls
options.body: Do not add the global preset and rely on channel-specific commentary settings such as the merged Slack control.

recommendation.title: Keep It Session-Level
recommendation.body: Retain `/verbose commentary` and session persistence while removing the global and per-agent default enum additions, avoiding the downgrade break.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the central normalization behavior and merged the adjacent compatibility-preserving Slack implementation.
